newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Leutenegger says Hancock bid is fair.
newsitem.headline: Leutenegger says Hancock bid is fair.

text.p: Hat-maker Leutennegger Ltd said on Wednesday that it believed the takeover bid by Hancock and Gore Ltd was fair and reasonable, in particular due to the target company's tight financial position.
The company said its shareholders should not reach a decision on selling their shares to Hancock until they had read the takeover documents and the independent experts report.

Leutenegger directors said, however, they had concluded the bid was in the interest of all shareholders as Hancock would help remove the company's financial instability which had been holding back profitability.
"By taking over Leutenegger, HGL can add value to the Leutenegger businesses," they said.
Hancock has offered one of its shares for every four Leutenegger shares, valuing the target company's shares at 30.75 cents each.
Leutenegger shares last traded at 27.5 cents on Friday.
